userRequest: Choose a durable background job library for asynchronous processing with scheduled retries.
successConditions: Multiple workers can claim durable jobs without duplicate concurrent processing.
Failed jobs retry with configurable backoff and survive application or worker restarts.

identityFacts: Every invoice job payload contains a tenant-scoped invoice identifier.
dataFacts: Invoice state and job state must remain in the existing PostgreSQL region.
operationalFacts: The platform provides a long-running Node worker deployment but will not add Redis.

hardConstraints.statement: The solution must use the existing PostgreSQL service and cannot require Redis.
Job state must survive request termination and be claimable by a separate worker.
The candidate must provide automatic retries with configurable backoff.

preferences.statement: Prefer the smallest operational footprint that meets the delivery guarantees.

reasonCodes.description: The case requires built-in retry and backoff behavior.
The case requires persistent shared job state and a separate worker.
The candidate uses the repository's existing PostgreSQL service.
The repository will not operate Redis.

unknowns.description: Production invoice throughput and worker sizing have not been benchmarked.
